stop_key.//: geometry in m, forces in N / (N/mm), tolerances in mm; every key not listed takes stopkit.DEFAULTS
stop_key.//x: null = centre of the real STOP key's top (bbox) = x 4.4 mm; y 0
stop_key.//r: cap d 40: geometric minor dimension 40 >= 35 (5 mm margin)
stop_key.//stroke: cap travel to its own stop (parallel guide: the same at every point of the cap) - covers tip gap worst case 3.16 + key switch travel <= 1.5
stop_key.//clear: skirt clearance to the lid at full stroke -> cap floats 5.5 over the lid
stop_key.//gap: tip to scanned key, closed lid: worst case -0.16 (key pre-pressed 0.16 < 0.3 switch travel) .. 3.16
stop_key.//arm: parallel links 70 long, 5.5 apart, stainless U-channels 12.2 x 2.8 x 0.8 (Euler 2450 N vs 223 N at the 1 J impact): the cap translates, never tilts (no drawer jam, no edge-force factor)
stop_key.//legend_w: STOP inlay 28 x 7.4 mm (Liberation Sans Bold), white 2K, reads from in front of the mower (the rear-hinged lid is operated from the front / side)
stop_key.//key: ASSUMED range of the real STOP key (fixed hardware, scanned): switch travel 0.3..1.5, full travel >= 0.8, switch force 3..15 N - supplier to confirm

h3.//: hingekit.DEF3 holds the defaults; keys here override them
h3.//int: [fix3-int] retuned for the TOTAL lid: fix-hinge 140.6 g + the STOP key parts from their meshes (26.0 g net incl. the skin they replace, stopkit.mass_mesh -> lidmech extra_mass) = 166.6 g; gravity torque 0.109 -> 0.141 N m closed, 0.032 -> 0.040 at 75 deg. With the fix-hinge spring (0.165 / 0.075 N m) the net opening torque incl. rail friction would be -0.008 N m closed and -0.017 at 20 deg: the lid would not open. No spiral in the 5.5 mm wide r 5 drum reaches +0.0134 at <= 897 MPa / fill <= 0.62 / <= 45 % of the available turns; a r 6 drum does not fit the pod (back flange 1.2 mm through the pod wall into the pocket). So the drum widens 5.5 -> 7.0 mm (r, tape lever, idler, drum position unchanged; still inside the 7.1 mm pod half-width; the pod's damper box follows, lidmech [fix3-int]) and the strip widens 4.5 -> 6.0 at the same 0.18 thickness: T 0.2175 -> 0.100 N m, rate 3.13 N mm/rad, L 180 mm, 0.67 turn preload open, sigma 887 / 408 MPa (<= 897, stress ratio 0.46 >= 0.455), fill 0.61, 44 % of the available turns. Net opening torque incl. friction +0.035 closed, min +0.021 at 25 deg (fix-hinge +0.0134), +0.052 at 75; with 5 % relaxation min +0.013. turns: drawn spiral length ~ L

lights.// lens: separate smoke PC lens (IR-transparent tint, hard-coat outside, dead-front IR-transparent black print inside except the light windows / pupil, silver ring print); gap = real joint to the body opening (was a 0.6 x 0.3 groove); roll_body / roll_lens = edge radii; t = lens thickness = wall
lights.// housing: black PC/ABS lamp housing, laser-welded to the lens back face (inner / outer wall faces weld_in / weld_out inside the outline (wall 1.5, the weld land between them) at u = weld_u); step_d / step_u = light trap step behind the gap and gasket face; d_out* = flange width beyond the outline (top / bottom / ends), d_trap over the charger slot (|y| < trap_y: no gasket, drain); gasket_in / gasket_edge = gasket band; u_back = back-plate depth by |y| (under the A-surface) per module; back_t; vent = [y, z, r] ePTFE vent
lights.// bar: PMMA light bar behind each light window: y0..y1, z0..z1 about the band axis, u0..u1 depth; 45 deg TIR periscope leg at leg_y..y1 down to leg_u; carrier_t = white PC carrier channel wall
lights.// board: LED end board (FR4) y0..y1, +-z_half, front face at u0, thickness t; led = [w, h, t] of the 3030 LED
lights.// pupil: front centre: board [half width, half height, front-face u], cam = [holder size, depth, barrel r, barrel front u], tof = [w, h, t], tof_y, led_y, pipe_r
lights.// dot: rear centre: board [half w, half h, front-face u], pipe_r, led
lights.// bosses: screw bosses on the body wall [|y|, dz] (dz 0: on the band axis at the lens end, else under the lens), od / hole (PT K25), seat_u = ear seat depth, ear_t / ear_w, gusset_t, sink = base fused into the wall, screw = [d, length, head d, head h]; fit_hole / slot = the locating holes of the two end ears (left round, right slot along y), clear_hole = lower ears
lights.// connector: sealed module connector on the back plate: y, dz, w, h, wall, shroud len, plug_len (right-angle plug, cable exits upward)
lights.// harness: cable_d per module; per module: path waypoints (world m) from the plug exit, grommet [x, y, z deck top, hole r, deck t], clips [x, y, z, foot direction, foot h], service [x, y, z, axis, cradle offsets 2x, deck z], chassis_lead waypoints; grommet_holes [x, y, rx, ry] are cut into the deck by design_gen
lights.// halo: status halo feed: clear boss r on the lid underside at the halo ring's front point, gap_closed to the emitter LED (lid closed), emitter = [x, y, t] LED board on the control panel's front strip, led_h; panel_z = panel top there
